title: hook-probe tests in a worktree import the main checkout's prusik, so a reviewer PASS can miss a hook regression
detail: sprint-cost: tests/test_hook_hot_path.py probes run sys.executable -c, which imports prusik from the venv's editable install (main checkout), not the worktree under test. The builder and regression-sentinel both ran the full suite green in worktrees/backend-builder while stop() spawned 4 git calls against a budget of 2; it surfaced only at sprint-complete from main. Workaround: PYTHONPATH=$PWD. Fix candidates: conftest pins PYTHONPATH to the repo root it runs from, or the probe passes its own sys.path.
